goal.request: Strengthen visual-semantic and candidate-pack support for boundary, limit, breakthrough, release, overload, phase-transition, and irreversible-crossing concepts, then test three independently randomized complex reference-guided renders.

evidence.claim: Dictionary, scientific, and safety sources distinguish threshold accumulation, physical breakthrough, limiter release, progressive overload, nucleation-growth phase transition, and irreversible crossing by observable relations rather than mood labels.
The supplied portrait supports bounded observable adult appearance cues only; identity and same-person status are outside the contract.
Six exact visual profiles, 36 profile-bound candidates, the real registry hook, rebuilt visual/semantic indexes, and focused regression checks passed.
evidence.artifact: tests/test_photo_boundary_transition_visual_semantics.py: 9 passed, 112 subtests; visual profile index check: 231 profiles and 1244 exact terms; semantic index: 7710 entries; audit_scene_expression.py --current: 112/112 routes and 0 failures

evidence.claim: All three independently composed prompts and their actual render requests passed contract audits with the assigned exact profile active and no cross-arm inputs.
Each arm delivered one saved native render from exactly one built-in image generation call, with zero retries and cross_arm_inputs_used=false.

The irreversible-crossing render passes continuity, threshold, and direction but fails lost return and committed consequence; the open tunnel and sunrise-like horizon keep the event reversible or ambiguous.
The phase-transition render passes all five profile gates and all five common gates in one ampoule at thumbnail and native scales.
The barrier-breakthrough render passes all five profile gates and all five common gates with a localized causal chain from ram contact through rupture and aperture crossing.
Root independently inspected native and thumbnail pixels, agreed with all three arm verdicts, and recorded a run-level 2/3 technical pixel pass with user judgment pending.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: For an exact activated concept, all profile-owned components and their causal or spatial relations must coexist visibly in one saved render; a partial relation, label, atmosphere, or plausible story is failure.

invariants.statement: Every exact profile is qualified by observable component relations, not by the abstract keyword alone.
All required profile and common gates must pass in the same render.
The attached portrait controls only observable adult appearance cues and never establishes identity.
Each randomized arm uses a frozen pre-core, no sibling inputs, one generation call, and no retry.

mismatches.source_state: The exact return path is visibly sealed, severed, collapsed, or otherwise physically unavailable after crossing.
mismatches.render_state: The damaged aft tunnel is burning but remains visibly open.

mismatches.source_state: An irreversible consequence is already visibly underway after the threshold is crossed.
mismatches.render_state: The orange Earth horizon is compatible with ordinary orbital sunrise and does not prove re-entry.

hypotheses.statement: Exact terms bound to five observable component groups, evidence fields, gates, and reject substitutes will preserve more visual meaning than advisory abstract labels alone.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact-profile prompts pass structurally but all independently generated renders lose the profile-owned relations.

hypotheses.statement: The current irreversible-crossing expression allows damage and downstream glow to remain merely suggestive instead of forcing an inspectable closed return path and unmistakable committed result.
hypotheses.falsifier: A fresh isolated one-call test using the unchanged profile shows both a physically unavailable return path and an unambiguous committed consequence.

intervention.general_rule: Route only narrow exact phrases into relation-complete visual obligations; keep broad limit, extreme, breakthrough, awakening, release, overload, transition, transcendence, and singularity terms advisory unless their required components are explicit.
intervention.generalization_basis: The six profiles encode domain-independent observable systems: pretransition accumulation, barrier rupture, limiter release, rated-system overload, same-specimen phase growth, and no-return crossing consequence.

decision.rationale: Structural and prompt behavior pass, and two isolated randomized renders fully preserve their assigned relations. The run cannot be promoted because the irreversible-crossing arm loses two defining relations in pixels; user aesthetic judgment is also pending.
